notes.title: Early Access Update #4 - Arctic Adventure Area Opened
notes.content:
[h1]V0.4.0 is now ready for download[/h1]

This update features the opening of a new area of the zoo - Arctic Adventure. 2 new animals are included for the main mode with this update: Polar Bear and the Penguin. Bots are also now available for the main game modes, allowing for single player games.

[b]Future Plans[/b]

At this time, we have regretfully decided to put a halt on all Zooicide updates to focus on our other projects.

Thanks
-Joe

notes.title: Early Access Update #3 - We're Back! Huge Character Rework, Lion and Rhino now Availible!
notes.content:
[h1]V0.3.0 is finally available! [/h1]

After a long arduous process, this update contains noteworthy changes to the core functionality of both humans and animals. We have removed the previously used rag-doll system in favor of animated characters to aim for smoother fighting and movement. We will continue to make changes to this throughout the remainder of our Early Access period based on your feedback.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29387728/a8cd8ee8888d4c7f9d7a1b43e7476ca221a88082.png[/img]

[b]Early Access Update #3 Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Gameplay
[list]
[*]Effects have been added for all limb losses to clearly display when you hit an enemy
[*]A slow mo effect is now rewarded when decapitating animals and humans 
[*]Most attack hit-boxes are now determined by a cubic area in front of the player, causing much more consistent attack landings
[/list]
[*]Humans
[list]
[*]Item grabbing is now determined by your camera view
[*]Animations have stabilized the aiming of weapons, most notably with firearms
[/list]
[*]Animals
[list]
[*] All animals have been given new animations with slight variations to their previous move-sets. Check them out and let us know what you think!
[/list]
[/list]

[b]New Animals: Lion and Rhino![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29387728/b780a5713410ff0ebbf9c9a7ffa41f6d1352cb04.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Rhino
[list]
[*]The Rhino is a fast moving beast which can fire it's mighty horn as a projectile in the most dangerous of circumstances. This animal has the following moves:
[list]
[*]Body Slam - Sideways attack with great force
[*]Horn Shoot - Forward shooting projectile
[*]Charge - Gives Rhino great speed, Can attack while sprinting
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Lion
[list]
[*] The Lion is an agile and scary animal, ready to attack at anytime, anywhere.
[list]
[*]Wall Climb - Can climb over many walls in the zoo
[*]Roar - Scares humans and animals alike into flying backwards
[*]Bite - Remove limbs with your strong powerful teeth
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Coming Soon, Our first expansion to The Zoo, Arctic Adventure![/b]

Arctic Adventure is scheduled to be released at the end of this November, it's release will come with several exciting new features
[list]
[*]The north area of the zoo will feature a new Arctic Exhibit
[*] 3 new animals to play as
[*] A special area-themed mini game
[*] Bots will also be added with this update
[/list]

Have Fun!
Joe

notes.title: Early Access Update #2 - Four New Items!
notes.content:
[h1]V0.2.1 is now ready for download![/h1]

This update adds some new items for the humans adding some mobility, damage and protection to fend off the animals. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29387728/eedae0e6d6b3237ec891744f423bfd6b3ee64304.gif[/img]

[b] Early Access #2 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Added four new items:[list]
[*] Grappling Hook - Great for covering long distances quickly
[*] Shotgun - Short range blast weapon for quickly killing large targets
[*]Riot Shield - Blocks attacks and knocks enemies back
[*]Body Armor - Blocks up to 5 attacks, then breaks [/list]
[*]Improved Melee weapon hitboxes
[*]Animal Outlines added to Brawl
[*] Armory Added!
[/list]

[b]Animal[/b]
[list]
[*] Eagle:[list]
[*] Reduced flight speed once a wing is lost
[*]Reduced dash speed
[*]Can no longer use abilities once wings are both lost[/list]
[*]Lion Coming Soon!
[/list]

[b]Plan for next update[/b]

     Over the next few weeks, we intend to overhaul some of the main mechanics regarding animal and human movement to make gameplay more fluid and consistent. We feel that this area is one that needs serious attention and we will be looking forward to your feedback on this.

[b]V0.2.1 Hotfix: [/b] Fixed a glitch where players could spawn as the lion

Have fun!

notes.title: Zooicide Early Access Update #1 - Elephant and Bald Eagle
notes.content:
[h1]V0.1.1 is now ready for download![/h1]

Happy Fourth Of July!

With this update we will be bringing out three new weapons, two new animals, bug fixes, and new features to make the game run more smoothly.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29387728/2c65e9b3c88cfa555dded7410acef7a7b4d996e6.gif[/img]

[h1]V0.1.1 Hotfix[/h1]

Chat has been added to the game!

[b] Early Access Update  #1 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Main mode music track added!
[*]Added a timer to Quickplay Mode, and as an option for classic and custom modes
[*]Three new items added: American Flag, Flashlight, and Hot Dogs
[*]Animal camera has been improved to jitter less
[*]Lights will automatcially come on when it reaches night in Animal Brawl
[*]Nighttime brightness has been increased
[*]Limbs have been balanced to require one item hit or animal ability to be knocked off, or two punches/basic attacks.
[/list]
[b]Animals[/b]
[list]
[*]2 New Animals! Welcome the Elephant and Eagle to the Zoo!
[*]Kangaroo can no longer jump off of multiple joeys
[*]Kangaroo can now walk slowly
[*]Ostrich and Kangaroo basic attack speeds are now slower
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Animals should no longer get stuck/slowed on stairs
[*]Removed a bug that allowed Kangaroo to use his ears to fly across the map
[*]Fixed humans being able to fly across the map in the sky with the chainsaw
[*]Fixed issue with Ostrich jumping off his eggs in mid flight
[*]Fixed spectate glitch that let the spectate camera appear even though you were controlling the animal
[/list]
[b]Menu[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Gameplay Hints in the Main Menu
[*]Added the option to change movement controls
[*][strike]Fireworks have been added to the main menu in celebration of the Fourth of July![/strike]
[/list]

Have fun!
Evil Tortilla Games
